incdirs.description: Include directories, relative to the workspace root. Searched after directories supplied through flags and build files.

compilationFilelist.description: Complete compilation filelist for package-first exploration. The path is workspace-relative and uses native -F semantics; nested -f/-F options retain their native meaning. This does not select a full RTL build.

explorePreincludeFiles.description: Ordered files prepended to separately parsed exploration-mode sources. Use real shared macro headers; relative paths are workspace-relative. Full builds retain their own compilation-unit preprocessing.

uvm.description: Explicit UVM library inputs. No library is injected unless configured. Source loading is independent of experimentalUvmPrefixCache.

fastCwdSnapshotChecks.description: Opt-in fast snapshot cwd checks (default false = strict). Requires the process working directory and its ancestors not to be moved, deleted or renamed during analysis. Ordinary source edits remain allowed. Checks phase boundaries; transient changes restored between checks are undetected. A changed/unavailable cwd discards the result and requires configuration reload. Filesystem lookup rules are unchanged.

experimentalMethodScopeOverlay.description: Experimental closed flat int method overlay. Default off. Phase one requires equal-length ASCII edits with fixed line layout and local count; unknown contexts and unsupported queries use the complete native path.

experimentalUvmPrefixCache.description: Experimental immutable UVM prefix reuse. Default off. External macros affecting UVM must come from command-line/configuration flags. Unsupported source changes or preprocessing state use native parsing.

experimentalUvmSemanticCache.description: Experimental semantic reuse of an explicitly configured, user-trusted immutable UVM library. Default off. Library files and dependencies are assumed unchanged until slang.rebuildUvmLibrary or configuration reload. No automatic dependency freshness is promised. Mutable user types and generic specializations remain per-consumer.

frozenSources.description: Frozen source selections and cache budget. Does not enable the experiment.

experimentalFrozenSources.description: Experimental package/module syntax and instance hierarchy reuse. Default off. Exact source and include lookup certification can cost filesystem I/O; changed inputs rebuild the native context while preserving editor overlays.

indexGlobs.description: Globs of what to index. By default will index all sv and svh files in the workspace.

index.description: Index configurations; by default indexes all .sv, .svh, .v, and .vh files in the workspace. External-only roots supplement this default. A workspace directory or an empty dirs entry replaces the default scan.

indexingThreads.description: Thread count to use for indexing

buildPattern.description: Build file glob pattern, e.g. `builds/{}.f`. Used for selecting build files. If omitted and no other build source is configured, defaults to matching all `.f` files in the workspace.

buildRelativePaths.description: Whether build files use paths relative to that file

wavesPattern.description: Waveform file glob to open given a build. Name and top variables can be passed with {name}, {top})

wcpCommand.description: Waveform viewer command ({} will be replaced with the WCP port), used for direct wcp connection with neovim and surfer.

inlayHints.description: Inline hints for things like ordered arguments, wildcard ports, and others

builds.description: Builds for direct .f selection or command-based .f generation

name.description: Optional name used for generated build files and UI labels

glob.description: Glob pattern to find files, like .f files or makefiles

command.description: Optional command that produces .f content on stdout when passed the selected file

packages.description: Exact package names in configured compilation inputs. The complete ordered roots through each selected package are retained, including preceding dependencies. Missing or ambiguous names are reported in status.

modules.description: Exact module definition names in configured compilation inputs. Retains complete ordered source roots; instance parameterizations are elaborated independently. Does not enable the experiment.

instances.description: Exact canonical RTL instance paths. Selects the instance and its descendants. Certified hierarchy values can survive supported class task body edits; other semantic changes rebuild natively. Requires a full design and does not enable the experiment.

maxMiB.description: Maximum charged retained cache size in MiB (0 to 512). With instance selectors, one quarter is reserved for certified hierarchy values. Current compilations can still own syntax after eviction; this is not a process RSS limit.

macroView.description: Macro code in hovers: 'source' preserves written source, 'expanded' shows generated code, 'both' keeps expanded code and its macro origin. Default both preserves the existing display.

docCommentFormat.description: How to render leading doc comments in hovers: 'markdown' renders as markdown, 'plaintext' escapes markdown characters, 'raw' shows the comment text verbatim including comment markers.

oneOf.description: Strip comment markers and escape markdown characters so the text renders as-is.
Strip comment markers and render the contents as markdown.
Show the comment text verbatim, including comment markers, in a code block.

excludeDirs.description: Exact directory names to exclude at all path levels, or specific workspace-relative paths starting with './' (absolute paths are also supported). Wildcards are not supported.

assignmentPatternTypes.description: Hints for inferred assignment pattern types

activeParameterValues.description: Hints for active instance parameter and localparam values

orderedInstanceNames.description: Hints for names of ordered ports and params

wildcardNames.description: Hints for port names in wildcard (.*) ports

funcArgNames.description: Function argument hints: 0=off, N=only calls with >=N args

macroArgNames.description: Macro argument hints: 0=off, N=only calls with >=N args

sourceDirectory.description: UVM source directory or distribution root, relative to the workspace. An existing project UVM is validated and retained; another version is never silently substituted.

entryFile.description: Optional UVM entry file, relative to sourceDirectory unless absolute. Otherwise locate uvm_pkg.sv directly or under src.

useBundled.description: Explicitly select the shipped UVM 1.2 sources. Default false. Mutually exclusive with sourceDirectory and entryFile. Conflicting project UVM inputs are rejected; no automatic injection or download.

semanticMaxMiB.description: Retention charge limit for the experimental trusted UVM semantic owner, in MiB (1..1024). Separate from frozenSources.maxMiB and process RSS. An oversized library uses native analysis.
